name: goron_city
label: Goron City
about: Pieces and textures cut from Goron City (spot18). Definitions only: the meshes come from the extract (ROM data) into out/. Coordinates are the builder's: x east, y north, z up (glTF's (x, -z, y)). See ADR 0036.

textures.about: Material N -> role (2026-10-09; every material is shaded by vertex colours). Spot18 draws the city several times over, once per room: room 3 (the view from the floor) has all of it and its materials get the plain names; rooms 0 and 2 (the upper tiers' views) repeat most of them, named `_up`. `ground` is the tiers' floors, `ledge_top` and `cobbles_edge*` the floors along their edges (a hay fringe), `tiles` the city floor, `cave_wall*` and `cliff` the walls (`wall_drawing` with a red Goron), `ceiling` the rock overhead, `steps` the ramp-stairs, `lava` the east lava pool, `gate_wall` the tunnel to the trail; `post_*` the banded railing posts, `rope_fence*` the railings, `rope*` the ropes over the centre, `hole*`, `mural_*` the translucent cave paintings; `carpet*`, `table_wood*`, `banner_b`, `pennant*` and `emblem` are Darunia's chamber (room 1). No floor has a detail texture.

surfaces.about: Surface type -> collision role (oot_import::level::ROLES), where the default read off the type (kit::default_role) is wrong.

pieces.name: gc_trail_gate
pieces.label: Gate to the trail
pieces.about: The tunnel up to Death Mountain Trail from the city's top tier: stone walls with pilasters (as the trail's Goron City gate), its floor rising to the exit (exit 1, about 210 in), fading to dark. The origin is the mouth's floor, facing out. Locked.

pieces.name: gc_woods_tunnel
pieces.label: Tunnel to the Lost Woods
pieces.about: The long straight tunnel to the Lost Woods from the second tier (exit 4's floor starts about 770 in). The origin is the mouth's floor, facing out. Locked.

pieces.name: gc_shop_door
pieces.label: Shop doorway
pieces.about: The low doorway to the Goron shop on the city's floor: a short tunnel whose whole floor is exit 3 (ENTR_GOLON_0). The origin is the mouth's floor, facing out. Locked.

pieces.name: gc_hub
pieces.label: Hub platform
pieces.about: A log-slice platform with a smaller stump on it, from the city's centre (the ropes that hold it are left out); wood footing, its stump's sides don't let Link grab.

pieces.name: gc_wood_ramp
pieces.label: Wooden ramp
pieces.about: A wedge of wood, 167 long and 42 high: a short ramp between ledges. There are three in the city.

pieces.name: gc_rope_railing
pieces.label: Rope railing
pieces.about: A lashed-rope railing (translucent lattice) with a corner, 700 long, along a tier's edge; collides.

pieces.name: gc_post_red
pieces.label: Banded post, red
pieces.about: A wooden post with two red bands and a cut top, 88 tall, at the ends of the city's railings. The city also has green, blue and olive ones.

pieces.name: gc_post_blue
pieces.label: Banded post, blue
pieces.about: The blue-banded version of the railing post.

pieces.name: gc_mural_dodongo
pieces.label: Dodongo mural
pieces.about: A cave painting of a Dodongo, translucent, drawn over two faces of the wall above the shop.

pieces.name: gc_mural_flames
pieces.label: Flame mural
pieces.about: A cave painting of flames, translucent.

pieces.name: gc_mural_gorons
pieces.label: Dancing Gorons mural
pieces.about: A cave painting of a line of dancing Gorons, translucent; its texture repeats as it grows.

pieces.name: gc_mural_goron
pieces.label: Goron mural
pieces.about: A cave painting of one dancing Goron, translucent.

pieces.name: gc_banners
pieces.label: Banner row
pieces.about: A row of four Goron banners (the triforce-and-spark crest), 120 wide; its texture repeats as it grows.

pieces.name: gc_hole
pieces.label: Cave hole
pieces.about: A dark cave hole painted on the wall (translucent): the city's look of Goron dwellings.

pieces.name: gc_hole_double
pieces.label: Double cave hole
pieces.about: A double cave hole painted on the wall (translucent).

pieces.name: gc_carpet
pieces.label: Carpet
pieces.about: The patterned rug by the shop on the city's floor (translucent).

pieces.name: gc_low_table
pieces.label: Low table
pieces.about: A low plank table on four legs, from Darunia's chamber (it has three).

pieces.name: gc_banner_row_b
pieces.label: Banner row, pale
pieces.about: A sagging line of pale banners strung along a wall of Darunia's chamber.

pieces.name: gc_emblem
pieces.label: Darunia's emblem
pieces.about: The black spiral emblem on the walls of Darunia's chamber (translucent).

pieces.name: gc_stairs_low
pieces.label: Ramp stairs, low
pieces.about: A switchback ramp-stair from the city's floor to the first tier (200 up): two flights with steps drawn on them and a landing, walled on its inner side. Locked: sized for Link.

pieces.name: gc_stove
pieces.label: Brick stove
pieces.about: A brick stove with a bent blue-stone chimney, in an alcove of the upper tier.
